post_vote_feedback.ending_effect: Personal costs and relationships are emotionally convincing, particularly Al invoking family without making them responsible, Brie defending staff, and Tess grieving an unfinished argument. post_vote_feedback.remaining_caveat: Material contradiction identifies a deceptive suspect convincingly, but innocent characters’ corrected side misconduct and assertions do not logically exclude their poisoning opportunity. Fair as a best-explanation game, weaker as uniquely deductive proof.
